caption: The drawing shows two objects on a plain, off-white background. The larger object, positioned towards the top left, resembles a bonnet with a curved outline, decorated with a pattern that includes floral motifs along the edges, dotted textures scattered throughout the central area, and vertical bands with spiral designs. The bonnet is outlined in black pencil, with light yellow coloring applied to parts of its surface, mainly in the dotted part and the bands near its edge. Below and slightly to the right, there is a smaller object with a rounded shape and outlined in pencil, featuring a cluster of floral designs in the center. The main focus is on outlines and delicate shading, with minor use of yellow color highlighting portions of the bonnet, while the smaller object remains mostly uncolored. Both objects are drawn in a simple, linear style with no background details.
